description: Semantic corrections applied after parsing Discord's preview OpenAPI document.

rules.reason: Snowflakes are unsigned 64-bit domain identifiers even when the schema accepts an integer representation.
Permission values must preserve bits unknown to this schema revision.
flags_new carries flag values that cannot be represented by the legacy fixed-width field.
Omission and explicit JSON null have different PATCH behavior.
Discord documents x-discord-union anyOf declarations as exclusive alternatives.
Unknown enum values must survive decoding and re-encoding.
Permission overwrite values have the same future-width contract as permissions.
IS_COMPONENTS_V2 cannot be unset and legacy content, embeds, stickers, and polls must be cleared during the upgrade.
OpenAPI unions do not express every nesting, cardinality, target exclusivity, or total component-count rule.
Modal-only components, Label wrappers, submitted values, and resolved entities require form-specific validation.
